context: Change _wrapper_script and _project/scripts/todo together. Add a stable template comment marker and export TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 before invoking todo-db. The marker is a caller-controlled compatibility handshake, not authentication or authorization. Implement a targeted wrapper refresh/config-recorded path or exact bounded replacement procedure; never use broad init-project --force or transparent self-update. Remove the hosted doctor turso-cli/whoami check and automatic-remint wording. Tests prove one invocation, no turso call, no token file, marker propagation, and unchanged non-auth behavior. Completion alone does not activate exit 4: hosted-auth-resolver-v2 must map auth failures to exit 2 with migration warning whenever the v2 marker is absent.
description: Remove control-plane credential minting from generated and checked-in wrappers before the v2 auth exit contract ships. V2 wrappers execute todo-db once, never call turso, never retry auth failures, create no token cache, export a non-secret TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT=v2 compatibility marker, print concise remediation, and propagate the binary's result. Existing committed wrappers are a migration hazard: provide a targeted refresh/detection path and pair the marker with the dependent resolver's legacy-safe exit mapping. Remove doctor's turso auth whoami network/account-identity check. This item supersedes its former 0600-cache proposal.

anti_patterns.dont: Cache a reminted token in a 0600 file
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD remove implicit minting and inject a provisioned token externally
anti_patterns.why: core would become a secret store without fixing parent-shell ownership or full lifecycle hazards

anti_patterns.dont: Treat the wrapper marker as a security credential
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD use it only to negotiate safe exit-code behavior
anti_patterns.why: any caller can set it and it carries no identity or capability

anti_patterns.dont: Use init-project --force as generic wrapper migration
anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD implement a targeted refresh path or exact bounded replacement procedure
anti_patterns.why: it can overwrite config and other scaffolding

preserves.behavior: Already-generated wrappers receive a detectable and documented migration path before missing-token exit 4 ships.
Legacy wrappers cannot receive the v2 exit-4 contract until the dependent resolver implements absent-marker suppression.
TODO_DB_AUTH_CONTRACT is only a compatibility handshake; it never proves identity, token validity, or capability.
Wrapper tool-resolution order, config discovery, arguments, stdout/stderr, and every non-auth exit code remain unchanged.
